mapper.select: SELECT t.tender_id, t.tender_code, t.tender_name, t.tender_type, t.tender_mode, t.purchaser_id, t.budget_amount, t.currency, t.tender_brief, t.publish_time, t.bid_start_time, t.bid_end_time, t.open_time, t.open_address, t.status, t.project_id, t.created_by, t.created_dept_id, t.created_post_id, t.created_time, t.updated_time, t.remark, p.company_name as purchaser_name, pr.project_name, pm.person_name as project_manager_name, creator.account_display as created_by_name, dept.org_name as created_dept_name, post.post_name as created_post_name FROM exp_tender t LEFT JOIN exp_company p ON t.purchaser_id = p.company_id LEFT JOIN exp_project pr ON t.project_id = pr.project_id LEFT JOIN exp_person pm ON pr.manager_person_id = pm.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON t.created_by = creator.account_id LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit dept ON t.created_dept_id = dept.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post post ON t.created_post_id = post.post_id WHERE t.tender_id = #{tenderId}

SELECT pr.project_id, pr.project_name, pr.manager_person_id as project_manager_id, p.person_name as project_manager_name, pr.org_id, org.manager_person_id as org_manager_id, org_p.person_name as org_manager_name FROM exp_project pr LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON pr.manager_person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit org ON pr.org_id = org.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_person org_p ON org.manager_person_id = org_p.person_id WHERE pr.project_id = #{projectId}
